name: Aman Tokyo
positioning: Aman's urban hotel in the Otemachi Tower in Tokyo, designed by architect Kerry Hill, with a large spa and a sushi restaurant led by chef Musashi
best_for: Travelers who want a spa and wellness-focused stay in central Tokyo
Sushi lovers who want omakase dining at the hotel

facts.text: Aman Tokyo is in the Otemachi Tower in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
Architect Kerry Hill played with the tenets of the Japanese house and its delineation of indoor and outdoor space in the lobby, using natural materials.
Aman Tokyo was the first urban property from the Aman brand.
Sliding washi-covered door panels open to a stone-laid bathroom with a furo bathtub overlooking the city.
At Musashi by Aman, chef Musashi serves omakase-style sushi and sashimi across a hinoki wood bar.
The rice that chef Musashi grows also goes into making his original sake and craft spirits.
The spa and wellness area covers 2,500 square metres over two floors.
The spa has eight treatment rooms.
Suite stays include access to wellness facilities with Japanese-style bathing facilities, steam rooms, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre.
Traditional Japanese acupuncture is available in the Aman Spa.
Aman-led excursions in the Nihonbashi area let guests order custom kimono, engrave their own chopsticks and decorate handmade fans.
